FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Luminous Lighting Co. specializes in the retail sale of high-quality lighting fixtures, bulbs, and accessories. Our primary operations are centered around a well-organized physical storefront located in Light City, CA, where we showcase a diverse range of products to enhance both residential and commercial spaces. We prioritize in-person customer interactions, allowing us to provide expert guidance and personalized service. 

Our inventory includes energy-efficient lighting solutions adhering to UL and ANSI safety standards, ensuring that all our products meet regulatory compliance. To maximize customer satisfaction, we also offer a limited selection of services; however, these services account for a small portion of our total revenue, as we focus primarily on retail sales. 

We maintain rigorous inventory management practices, including cycle counts and secure storage, to prevent shrinkage and ensure product availability. In addition, all our operations are supported by a centralized alarm system to protect our valuable inventory. With a commitment to quality, safety, and customer service, we continually seek to build strong relationships with our vendors and customers alike.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On June 15, 2023, a small fire caused by a faulty electrical fixture resulted in damage to our inventory, totaling $5,000. The situation has been resolved and no claims are currently outstanding.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM, Saturday: 10:00 AM - 4:00 PM, Sunday: Closed
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing installed around the perimeter of the property and monitored by central station alarm services.
